'''Hogan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] present in [[Republic Power Generation]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hogan appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the moon [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
